predecessors.name: Federal Republic of Central America
predecessors.text: El Salvador: 'In 1824, the two jurisdictions were united in the State of Salvador, a part of the Federal Republic of Central America'

ledger.x: 1839: the federation is dissolved and the State of Salvador stands alone.
1841: the State of Salvador declares itself a sovereign republic.

wars.name: Football War
wars.outcome: The page names it only as an effect of the expulsion or flight of 'as many as 130,000 Salvadorans' from Honduras; it gives no battles, occupation or treaty, and no change of border.

wars.name: Salvadoran Civil War
wars.outcome: Ended by the Chapultepec Peace Accords, signed on 16 January 1992 by President Alfredo Cristiani and the FMLN; no territory changed hands on the page.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a boundary survey or treaty line: the Federal Republic page and the El Salvador page are silent on the Guatemalan and Honduran frontiers, the 1980 peace treaty and the 1992 ICJ ruling.
